# opnsense_acmeclient_certificate (Data Source)

Retrieves an ACME Client certificate from the OPNsense os-acme-client plugin by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_acmeclient_certificate" "example" {
  id = "<uuid>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the ACME certificate.

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) UUID of the ACME account used to request the certificate.
- `aliasmode` (String) DNS alias mode.
- `alt_names` (Set of String) Subject Alternative Names (DNS names).
- `auto_renewal` (Boolean) Whether automatic renewal is enabled.
- `cert_ref_id` (String) Trust store certificate reference ID after successful issuance.
- `challengealias` (String) Challenge alias used when `aliasmode` is `challenge`.
- `description` (String) Optional description for this certificate.
- `domainalias` (String) Domain alias used when `aliasmode` is `domain`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this certificate is enabled.
- `key_length` (String) Private key length or type.
- `last_update` (String) Timestamp of the last certificate update.
- `name` (String) Common Name (CN) for the certificate.
- `ocsp` (Boolean) Whether OCSP Must-Staple is enabled.
- `renew_interval` (String) Days before expiry to attempt renewal.
- `restart_actions` (Set of String) UUIDs of ACME restart actions to run after issuance or renewal.
- `status_code` (String) Last known certificate status code.
- `status_last_update` (String) Timestamp of the last certificate status update.
- `validation_method` (String) UUID of the ACME validation method used for challenges.
